_about: What each quest asks him to bring or make, and the ingredients its own step names (quest log step text, build 26161880). A fresh player starts these quests holding none of them: tools.quest_clone strips them from a clone's bag, and tools.quest_run marks a run 'not counted: deliverable carried' when he holds any at its start. Tools he works with (axe, pickaxe, weapons) are not deliverables (main, 2026-11-01).

amounts._about: How many of a deliverable the quest's step asks for, where it names a number. tools.quest_run.head_start: a leftover under a tenth of it at the start is not a head start (main, 2026-11-16).

_steps.Getting Started: Build a Crafting Table and craft a Stone Club. Then bring it to Doric.
_steps.Ratcatcher: Kill rats and successfully cook one rat roast from their meat.
_steps.Rune Mysteries: Bring 50 Ash Logs to Zanik. / Mine Rune Essence, craft some Air and Astral Runes by building a Rune Altar or from Siphoning Anima Vents.

_persistence_ids_source: The save's GameProgress.Inventory slot keys are the InventoryComponent ItemSlots index (get_state 'raw'). Joined slot by slot: logs/quests/clones/ClaudeQ5.json against his first live bag read after that clone loaded (logs/brain-live-20261101-214338-8632.jsonl, 21:43Z); the counts agree in every slot (e.g. 560 Water Runes, 1949 Astral Runes, 13 Rune Essence).
